-- Insert Howard vs UMBC completed game (FirstFour-3, Midwest 16v16)
-- Howard (60051) beat UMBC (60050) 86-83 on March 17
INSERT INTO gameResults (year, round, matchupId, espnGameId, espnStatus, team1Id, team2Id, team1EspnId, team2EspnId, winnerId, team1Score, team2Score, isComplete, isScored, playedAt)
VALUES (2026, 'firstfour', 'FirstFour-3', '401856433', 'STATUS_FINAL', 60051, 60050, '47', '2378', 60051, 86, 83, 1, 0, '2026-03-17T22:40:00Z');

-- Now retroactively score FirstFour-0 picks (Texas, id=60027, won)
-- Update picks where matchupId=FirstFour-0 and pickedTeamId=60027 (Texas)
UPDATE picks 
SET isCorrect = 1, pointsEarned = 5, actualWinnerId = 60027
WHERE matchupId = 'FirstFour-0' AND pickedTeamId = 60027 AND isCorrect IS NULL;

-- Mark incorrect picks for FirstFour-0 (NC State, id=60028)
UPDATE picks 
SET isCorrect = 0, pointsEarned = 0, actualWinnerId = 60027
WHERE matchupId = 'FirstFour-0' AND pickedTeamId = 60028 AND isCorrect IS NULL;

-- Score FirstFour-3 picks (Howard, id=60051, won)
UPDATE picks 
SET isCorrect = 1, pointsEarned = 5, actualWinnerId = 60051
WHERE matchupId = 'FirstFour-3' AND pickedTeamId = 60051 AND isCorrect IS NULL;

-- Mark incorrect picks for FirstFour-3 (UMBC, id=60050)
UPDATE picks 
SET isCorrect = 0, pointsEarned = 0, actualWinnerId = 60051
WHERE matchupId = 'FirstFour-3' AND pickedTeamId = 60050 AND isCorrect IS NULL;

-- Mark game 31 as scored
UPDATE gameResults SET isScored = 1 WHERE id = 31;

-- Check how many picks were scored
SELECT matchupId, isCorrect, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(pointsEarned) as totalPts FROM picks WHERE matchupId IN ('FirstFour-0', 'FirstFour-3') GROUP BY matchupId, isCorrect;
